title: Vatican envoy Cardinal Matteo Zuppi visits Moscow on humanitarian mission
body:
Cardinal Matteo Zuppi, president of the Italian Episcopal Conference, was sent by Pope Francis as a peace envoy to Ukraine and Russia in June 2023. He visited Ukraine on 5 and 6 June 2023, praying at St Sophia Cathedral in Kyiv and at Bucha before the graves of civilians killed by Russian troops in March 2022. He met President Volodymyr Zelensky, Ukrainian human rights commissioner Dmytro Lubinets, who raised the issue of Ukrainian children in Russian-occupied territories and detained civilians, and representatives of the Council of Churches and Religious Organizations.

Zuppi then visited Moscow from 28 to 30 June 2023. There he met Yuri Ushakov, foreign policy adviser to the Russian president, Maria Lvova-Belova, the Russian presidential commissioner for children's rights, and Patriarch Kirill of Moscow and All Russia. He also met the bishops of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Russia and concelebrated in the Catholic cathedral in Moscow.

On 5 July 2023 in Rome, Zuppi said that returning Ukrainian children home was a key priority and that the Vatican wanted to begin with the youngest and most fragile. He said the next step was to check on the children and then work out how to bring them back, adding that "the children must be able to return to Ukraine". He confirmed that he had met Pope Francis after the visits.
